threat_event: The credit decision model gives inaccurate adverse action reasons or produces disparate outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes not revalidated after the 2026 retraining; fairness testing partial
existing_controls: Model risk committee; adverse action notices generated from reason codes
treatment_plan: Reason code validation; fairness testing; change gate (P10)

threat_event: Rewards Card numbers skimmed on the retail checkout are used for fraud and trigger notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card number and code typed on an affiliate page outside the Safeguards program's view
existing_controls: Fraud scoring on Rewards Card authorizations
treatment_plan: Isolated payment frame run by Financial Services; reissue playbook

threat_event: The card processing platform vendor is breached or unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Oversight relies on SOC reports without mapping complementary user entity controls
existing_controls: SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports; contract with notice terms
treatment_plan: Safeguards-based vendor review; complementary control mapping; exit plan

threat_event: Cardholder accounts are taken over through call center social engineering or SIM swap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based questions at the call center
treatment_plan: Call center step-up with app push or one-time code

threat_event: Synthetic identities open Rewards Card accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Instant credit at store kiosks and online
existing_controls: Red Flags program; identity verification vendor
treatment_plan: Add device and velocity signals to application screening

threat_event: Cardholders who opted out of affiliate marketing still receive offers built on their card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Opt-outs not sent to the CDP
treatment_plan: Daily opt-out feed to the CDP

threat_event: The Safeguards program misses service provider oversight and reporting elements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 standards; 2025 Qualified Individual report omitted the card platform review
existing_controls: Written information security program; annual report
treatment_plan: Re-issue standards; complete 2026 report content by 2026-12-31

threat_event: A notification event involving 500 or more consumers is not reported to the FTC within 30 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group IR plan and matrix do not include the 314.4(j) notice
existing_controls: Financial Services CISO aware of the duty
treatment_plan: Add the FTC notice to the group matrix and the division IR plan

threat_event: Customer information is kept more than two years after last use without a reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closed account data retained indefinitely in the data store
treatment_plan: Automated disposal job for closed accounts

threat_event: A call center agent misuses cardholder data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents see full account and contact data

threat_event: A consumer report is pulled without a permissible purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prescreen and account review pulls run by analysts
treatment_plan: Monthly reconciliation of pulls to applications and reviews

threat_event: A model or rule change breaks the mapping from model factors to adverse action reasons
Ransomware on the call center and collections platforms stops servicing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Telephony and collections tools on shared workforce endpoints
existing_controls: EDR; backup line through the processor
treatment_plan: Tested fallback for lost or stolen card reporting

threat_event: Unencrypted cardholder data in analytics exports to the CDP is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports land in an object store before load
treatment_plan: Direct encrypted transfer without landing files

threat_event: The generative AI service assistant gives a cardholder wrong information about dispute rights
existing_controls: Approved answer library for disputes; hand-off to agents
treatment_plan: Dispute questions always routed to an agent (P10)

threat_event: Consumer report information is not properly destroyed at disposal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper applications at stores sent to a shredding vendor
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Financial Services CISO (Low)
